Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash

Clothing:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Sleepwear
- Undergarments
- Socks and underwear
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Footwear:
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Water shoes for snorkeling
- Comfortable walking shoes for hiking
- Dressier shoes for nice dinners

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (optional, can rent)
- Beach bag
- Reusable water bottle

Hiking & Outdoor:
- Hiking gear (appropriate footwear, moisture-wicking clothes)
- Day backpack
- Insect repellent
- Portable first aid kit
- Trail snacks

Electronics:
- Camera with waterproof case
- Phone charger
- Universal power adapter
- Portable power bank
- Headphones

Toiletries:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if needed)
- Contact lenses and solution (if needed)
- Prescription medications

Miscellaneous:
- Travel pillow
- Eye mask and earplugs
- Books or e-reader
- Travel guide for Hawaii
- Small daypack for excursions
- Laundry bag
- Ziplock bags for wet items

Activities-Specific Items:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach toys, cooler
- June 12 (Snorkeling): Underwater camera
- June 13 (Diamond Head Hiking): Extra water, trail map
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Respectful attire
- June 15 (North Shore): Car essentials, cooler
- June 16 (Luau): Hawaiian shirt/dress (aloha attire)
- June 18 (Kayaking): Quick-dry clothes, waterproof bag
- June 19 (Shopping): Reusable shopping bags
